title: pleurostylia opposita
intro: Pleurostylia opposita, commonly known as the Indian plum or wild plum, is a plant species in the Celastraceae family native to the tropical forests of the Western Ghats in India. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
